title: Hierarchical condition x behavior code composition on held-out pairs
hypothesis: On two frozen synthetic activation-function worlds, a rank-4 condition code plus rank-4 behavior code fitted from 48 of 64 pairs will predict all 16 held-out condition-behavior activation functions at relative RMSE <=0.05, use <=0.50x actual bytes of an explicit 64-pair function table, and provide at least a 10% useful margin over CAST/native additive factorization at equal quality.
physical_object: One frozen 64-dimensional activation function chart with 8 condition factors, 8 behavior factors and 64 possible conditional functions.
mirror_coordinate: A learned condition address code and a learned behavior address code decoded through separately shared bases, composed additively for each requested pair.
logical_multiplicity: 64 indexed condition-then-behavior functions, of which 16 whole pair identities are withheld from fitting and evaluated zero-shot.
controls: Explicit CAST-style condition vectors plus behavior vectors added for a requested pair
Ordinary native additive two-factor regression with PCA/SVD compression of its factor vectors
No-composition baseline that has no output for held-out pairs

task.whole_pair_split: Deterministic 48/16 pair split with every condition and behavior ID represented among visible training pairs; held-out pair list is generated and saved before fitting.
task.construction: A requested pair (c,b) has target activation delta u_c + v_b + rho*p_cb, where u and v live in independent four-dimensional orthonormal subspaces, each component has unit norm, and p_cb is a seeded unit private vector. The visible-pair least-squares additive fit uses only the 48 visible vectors. Whole held-out pair IDs are never used for fitting or basis construction.
task.primary_metric: Relative Frobenius RMSE of predicted versus target activation deltas over all held-out pairs.

development.selection: Report fixed private-rho and matched basis-rank grid. Primary gate is rank4/rank4 at rho=0; rho=.1/.25 are private-frontier diagnostics only.
development.hyperparameter_changes_after_run: Prohibited without numbered amendment; source/tests freeze first.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if rank4/rank4 passes quality and actual-byte gates and shows >=10% useful function/storage/compute margin versus native additive factorization.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all condition/behavior factors or full pair functions
both shared bases and all factor codes
storage.common_pair_query: Condition and behavior indices arrive as the function request and are common to all methods.

compute.active_operation_proxy: CAST additive lookup uses 2D element reads plus D additions; rank-r Mirror/native decode uses 2Dr multiplies for the two factors plus D additions; explicit function table uses D element reads.

gates.PROMISING: In both development seeds at rho=0/rank4, held-out relative RMSE <=0.05 and actual payload <=0.50x explicit full-pair table, plus >=10% useful margin versus native additive/PCA control at equal quality.
gates.FAIL: Quality or actual-byte gate misses, or native additive/PCA exactly explains Mirror functions/storage/compute without the required useful margin.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: The visible pair graph omits a condition/behavior factor or explicit full-table outputs cannot replay exactly.

boundaries: Synthetic vector-function composition only; not an LM, language task, semantic CAST, or user-preference result.
Only the 16 evaluated held-out pair outputs count; the 64 address combinations do not by themselves count as independent capacity.
The native additive factorization is a mandatory direct control and is expected to be algebraically equivalent; report an exact alias as a Mirror attribution failure.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless every frozen gate including native attribution passes.
